source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

hinge.title: Classify a motion as linear when the object's path is a straight line.

intelligence.enrichment: When an object moves along a straight line, its motion is called linear motion. straight-line path -> linear motion classification The learner correctly applies this rule: When an object moves along a straight line, its motion is called linear motion. Linear motion means any object moving forward or along something that looks ordinary, regardless of the actual path shape.
